page.notes: The left strip shows the facing page only as cropped fragments of small marginal text and Hebrew, too damaged to read, so it is not transcribed. Several Greek words on the right page are set in a dense printed hand and are transcribed from the scan with some uncertainty; accents and breathings may not match the print exactly. The section heading "Σ." and the closing "Z" are printed; the "Z" is a catchword-style letter at the foot and is left out of the text.
